launch_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
cd /root/Leanputer
export PYTHONPATH=/mnt/scratch/leanputer-runs/architecture-budget/fla-core-0.3.2:/root/Leanputer
export TORCHINDUCTOR_FREEZING=1
export TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/mnt/scratch/leanputer-runs/architecture-budget/inductor
export TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/mnt/scratch/leanputer-runs/architecture-budget/triton
log=/mnt/scratch/leanputer-runs/architecture-budget/current-small-source-stock.log
date -u > "$log"
git rev-parse HEAD >> "$log"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 1200s /mnt/scratch/leanputer-native-venv/bin/python -u -m tools.kernel_compact_stock --config benchmarks/kernel-full-source-stock/config.json --source benchmarks/kernel-full-source-stock/source.jsonl --report /mnt/scratch/leanputer-runs/architecture-budget/current-small-source-stock.json --max-forwards 231000 --offline-check >> "$log" 2>&1
result_code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$result_code" > /mnt/scratch/leanputer-runs/architecture-budget/current-small-source-stock.exit
date -u >> "$log"
exit "$result_code"
